subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Sumeru Adventurers' Guild and talk to Katheryne

80190101.text: Ah, perfect! It's you two. I have a commission here that has your names written all over it. In fact, I'd even go so far as to say you're the only ones for the job.

80190102.text: The only ones for the job? Huh, if our help is really that important, it's probably some Archon-class commission, right?

80190105.text: Hehe... The Adventurers' Guild doesn't employ that kind of classification system. In fact, this commission is also probably not nearly as intimidating as what you're expecting.

80190106.text: All it asks us to do is to find a missing person.

80190107.text: Huh... Then why did you say we were the only ones for the job?

80190108.text: I came across this commission while reviewing our backlog not too long ago.

80190109.text: It seems simple, but our records indicate that over a dozen successive efforts to complete it have all ended in failure, despite attempts by several accomplished and renowned adventurers.

80190110.text: With the reputation of the Adventurers' Guild and the performance of the Sumeru branch at stake, it's in our best interest to assign this commission to the adventurer with the highest completion rate over the past few years...

80190201.text: I really hope he's okay. Please, we're counting on you to find him.

80190301.text: Hello there! You looking to buy something? I do business in this area...

80190302.text: Oh, no, no. We're adventurers! Katheryne sent us to look into a commission here in Vimara Village...

80190303.text: Ah, so you're here about that, then... *sigh* You're not the first, that's for sure. We've certainly made a lot of trouble for you all.

80190304.text: To be honest, we aren't holding out much hope. Many adventurers have made their way out here, confident they'd be able to help us, only to leave soon after with nothing to show for their efforts.

80190305.text: We've pretty much had it up to here in questions, and the area around the village has practically been overturned in search of clues. But, no one has been able to make any headway...

80190306.text: So this person we're looking for... What's his name? Where did he live? Does he have any relatives?

80190307.text: I don't know. I really have no clue. I couldn't tell you.

80190308.text: Okaayy... Guess you really are sick of answering questions.

80190309.text: Ah... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to sound short with you. I was actually just giving you my answer to your questions.

80190312.text: I know it may seem like we don't have anything to offer by way of information, but I promise you we all have a very strong impression of him. When you live in the same village as someone, you develop a lot of memories together, y'know?

80190313.text: We just don't know the specifics. Maybe we did at one point, but that information is long gone by now...

80190314.text: At least, that's what everyone in the village seems to think. We've all exchanged what we know, and that was the only logical conclusion.

80190315.text: Alright, specifics aside, then... What kind of person was he?

80190316.text: Young guy, in his early twenties probably. Incredibly kind sort of person, always willing to lend a helping hand...

80190317.text: I'd chat with him when I didn't have any customers. I even saw him stick out his neck for others on more than one occasion, haha... Very interesting guy, that one.

80190318.text: Now that you've started talking about him, you don't seem nearly as down in the dumps as you did before. Seems like he left a pretty good impression on you.

80190319.text: But of course! Everyone in the village is pretty fond of him. We wouldn't have issued that commission otherwise.

80190320.text: There aren't many young people like him nowadays, so genuine and pure. To think that he just up and disappeared one day... I just hope nothing bad happened...

80190321.text: Could he have just... moved away without telling anyone?

80190322.text: No. He's not the type to leave without saying goodbye. And anyway, moving away without being seen by a single person in the village? There's no way he would've been able to manage that...

80190323.text: Huh... All right. Thanks for the information! We're gonna go ask around some more.

80190402.text: Hi, Grandpa Amadhiah! We're here to help you look for the guy that's gone missing.

80190403.text: Ah, so that's what brings you to these parts! Coming all this way for our sake... That's so very kind of you. With your help, I trust that young man's case is in good hands.

80190404.text: Could you tell us a bit about him?

80190405.text: Of course! I'm happy to help any way I can.

80190406.text: With my failing eyesight, I'm afraid I can't offer much about his appearance. But, I do remember hearing the sound of his voice... Not recently, of course. That loss has left me feeling quite empty.

80190407.text: I don't think his parents are still living in the village. But, somehow, he never seemed lonely. In fact, he was usually the one offering companionship to others.

80190408.text: He would often take time to visit the elderly or play with the orphans in the village.

80190409.text: And whenever someone had something on their mind, he was there to listen with open ears. He always knew just what to say.

80190410.text: As the village chief, I owe him many thanks. Helping villagers navigate difficult moments in their lives should have been one of my responsibilities, but he was often the one rising to the occasion.

80190411.text: Wow, he seems like such a nice and gentle person! No wonder his disappearance affected you all so much.

80190412.text: But, um... You wouldn't happen to know any details about his name, address, or family situation, right?

80190413.text: *sigh*... I'm ashamed to admit it, but... I just can't remember. No matter how you look at it, I should know those things, but for some reason, no matter how hard I try to remember, the information just doesn't come. Perhaps my age really has caught up with me this time...

80190414.text: Ah... It's okay! There's no need to force yourself to try and remember. We'll figure something out...

80190418.text: Paimon thinks so too! Like the name thing... It's so weird that no one remembers his name.

80190419.text: And nobody has been able to tell us anything about his family or where he lived... It's like this guy's been erased from reality or something.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the place indicated by Atossa

80190501.text: Is this the place? Under this tree?

80190502.text: Yep. I know it doesn't look like much, but this place is very meaningful to me. It's so full of memories...

80190503.text: We used to always sit together under this tree and talk. Sometimes, we would look up at the clouds in the sky, or stop to feel the wind against our skin. We could sit there for hours at a time, never realizing how long it had been...

80190504.text: I was actually adopted by the people of Vimara Village. The Forest Rangers found me in the woods as a child.

80190505.text: I was surrounded by such good people, and growing up in the village was so lively. Still... there were times when I couldn't help but feel incredibly alone...

80190507.text: *sigh*... How should I put it? When something's bothering you, or when you have good news to share, you always want to talk about it with somebody. But, for the longest time, I didn't know who I could talk to, or if I should say anything at all...

80190508.text: Everyone has their own problems to deal with. Even if I might want to confide in others, I don't want to become a burden.

80190511.text: Really? You know exactly how I feel?

80190601.text: While you two are out searching, I'll also try and see what I can remember... If I think of something, I'll be sure to let you know.

80190701.text: Thank you so much! I wasn't expecting monsters to show up. If you hadn't been here, I'm not sure what I would've done...

80190705.text: Hmm, now that I think about it, the Hilichurls around Vimara Village have been a lot more active lately...

80190706.text: They seem agitated, and would often attack anything in sight. Chief Amadhiah doesn't allow the children to play in the area around the village anymore.

80190707.text: Huh... Maybe the Abyss Order really is involved...

80190708.text: Well, we should head back and check out the situation in Vimara Village just in case. If the Abyss Order is plotting something, that could spell trouble for the villagers.

80199901.text: We made it to Vimara Village! Why don't we talk to some of the villagers to learn a bit more about the missing guy?

80199902.text: If this commission is really as challenging as Katheryne made it out to be, we're gonna need to carry out a very detailed investigation!
